_about: Category labels for index-coded (categorical) colour tables, keyed by LUT name.
A LUT listed here is drawn as a discrete legend: one block per group, showing the colours of
its indices side by side with the label underneath. A LUT absent from this file is drawn as a
continuous gradient with just its name, so this file is purely additive and affects no
'indices' are raw pixel values, which for an indexed image are also the LUT entry numbers.
Grouping merges entries naming one feature (a coronal hole and its boundary) into one block,
which is how these maps are conventionally presented.
Keys starting with '_' are ignored by the loader.
_about CH/Polarity Legend: Transcribed from Ian Hewins' '20 in Color Table.docx', the source of truth for the McIntosh
Archive (Digital Ontology) maps. Labels are that document's own names. Indices 0/1 (white and
black background) and 14/15 (documented as unused) deliberately carry no legend entry.
Listed: the traced solar features. Omitted: Missing (11) and Border (12), which mark a data
gap and the chart frame rather than anything on the Sun, and the AIA CH-boundary indices
(16-19), unused in this product. Omitted colours still render where they occur in the data --
this file only controls what the legend lists.
